install.title: Install on the phone
install.iphone: On iPhone: open this page in Safari, tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.android: On Android: open this page in Chrome, tap the menu, then "Add to Home screen" or "Install app".
install.after: After that, open Companion from the home screen icon. It works without internet.
install.entry: To change anything, tap "For carers" at the bottom of the Today screen and enter your PIN.
install.sameApp: Do the setup inside the home screen app. A page open in Safari and the home screen icon keep separate data.
install.textSize: Make the text bigger in the phone's Settings under Accessibility. The whole app follows that setting.
